recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future wording changes to Observation.code should be made under later targeted Observation issues rather than adding redundant DSTU1-era prose for FHIR-5467.
issue_request: FHIR-5467 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 OO technical correction for FHIR-core Observation asking to add more explanation to the observation "code" wording because the element uses CodeableConcept and supports coded concepts plus text/display.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5467. Adjacent DSTU1 history shows git d6259fa8e3beda8fd5e58ad54d85001f1efb9d42 applying FHIR-5276 by renaming Observation.name to Observation.code in the Observation spreadsheet, examples, profiles, and introduction; the current source was later refactored into structuredefinition-Observation.xml.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Observation.code work, especially FHIR-50189 and git 7c5ba56701d7b3ab6c814afd65f31d1fe2947242, expanded the current Observation.code comment and links to the code/value interoperability notes. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-5467 found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Observation.code element is CodeableConcept, defines the element as the type/name of what was observed, explains how code-value pairs determine observation meaning, and links to narrative guidance covering Observation.code/value concept-code patterns.

related_jiras.note: DSTU1 ballot issue that renamed Observation.name to Observation.code and provides the nearby application history for FHIR-5467's terminology.
Later OO issue/source change that clarified Observation.code comments and reinforces that the current source already explains code/value meaning.
